summary: Logs, metrics and traces are connected by a request id. You give every request an id in the Python service (the caller's if its shape is safe, otherwise a new one), return it on the response, write it on every log line and in the audit log, and follow one request through the gateway and the service by searching for it. A slow first request shows why.
goal: Follow one request through .NET and Python by id.

items.text: Add observability.py and the middleware: an id on the response, in the log line and in the audit log
Send a request with your own id and one without, predict the response headers, and grep your logs
Send an unsafe id (a space, a semicolon, 100 characters) and say why it is replaced
Write what you still want to know about a slow request
Play the Follow the Request game to the end and see your score
